summary: Full-extraction pass over 20 stored Korean documents (17 ACRC press releases 2021-2026, the 2019 ACRC work plan, and the 2001 Anti-Corruption Act and 2002 decree). Added splits by type of report and by area, five-year totals, supplementary payments, award recipients, 2017-2018 plan figures, about 90 reward and award cases, restated rules and two proposed rule types. The 2024 quarterly releases keep a to-do: their pie-chart images list every area, and OCR could not tie the small slices to their values.
